ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with high-intensity (white) patches concentrated at distal lobe tips. Approximate macro-level ratio of 75:25 (low-to-high intensity).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast contiguous white blobs at the distal lateral tips of both lobes. Central and proximal regions characterized by dark pigmentation with an overlay of scattered high-intensity circular nodes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire visible boundary. Peak-to-valley amplitude is most pronounced on the outer thirds of both fluke lobes, transitioning to smoother topography near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve extending from the central notch to the distal tips, terminating in tapered, slightly rounded endpoints.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely distributed circular and annular high-contrast pixel clusters (white on dark background) consistent with barnacle colonization scars, visible across both ventral lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions observed, most notably in the lower-central region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring constellations and a distinct irregular notch-like indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe roughly one-third of the distance from the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, dark linear pigmentation streak bisects the large white contiguous field on the right distal lobe tip.
